verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses data retention controls, deletion policies, or privacy/data-lifecycle management for Stripe Terminal; the docs focus on payments, hardware, receipts, and fleet management with no mention of retention/deletion settings. Missing for 10: any documentation of data retention policy, configurable deletion/erasure controls, or compliance tooling (e.g., GDPR/CCPA data deletion API) for Terminal-collected data.
